=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1676-1706 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The window marker is written whenever WLA_WINDOW_START, WLA_WINDOW_END and GITHUB_RUN_ID are valid, but it records no repository scope. Single-repo runs therefore publish a marked report: a repos_override dispatch, a gate run with WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_GATE_ALL_REPOS=false (test-and-mark-stable.yml:4261 sends repos_override=${TEST_REPO}), and an explicit-since dispatch. The since_last_report reader (around lines 248-256 / 209-296) takes the largest window_end and does not check which repos each report covered.
  WHY: The next since_last_report=true full-roster run starts collecting at the single-repo report's window_end and silently skips runs from every other roster repo, which breaks the "overlap only, never a gap" promise at lines 1680-1681. All reviewers rated it MAJOR; confidence ranged from 3 to 4.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2070-2100 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the direct `gh pr merge --squash` succeeds, possibly only by enqueueing the PR in a merge queue as the comment at 2072-2073 admits, the code sets report_merge_requested="direct" and keeps the `git rm` purge deletions. The purge-drop block (2081-2093/2099) runs only in the `else` (auto-merge) branch.
  WHY: An apply-analysis project can start reading a doc while the PR waits in the queue, and the queued merge then deletes that doc: the #7022 hazard. The wait loop at 2124-2135 cannot re-check the in-flight guard. All flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5's notes dispute it: they call it base code and say the processing-report-based purge (lines 1858-1864) closes the hazard.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2085 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The purge-drop `git commit --amend` replaces the commit message built at lines 1885-1889, which includes "purged ${purged_count} older than ${retention_raw}d", with the fixed string "chore: add workflow log analysis report".
  WHY: There is no runtime failure, but the purge accounting is lost from git history and the squash body whenever auto-merge is armed with the deletions dropped. All rated it NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5's notes call it base code and only cosmetic.
- agents.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md:6 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The expanded "Workflow architecture" paragraph, mirrored in changelog.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md, adds to rendered instructions. The copilot-pull-request-reviewer check fails with `custom_instructions_too_large` (run 42816240191, job 129829960221).
  WHY: No automated Copilot review is produced. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes it cannot confirm whether this PR's growth causes the failure or whether it predates the PR on the merge base. Both rated it NIT.
- agents.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md:6 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The P1 fragment, and changelog.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md lines 1-7, were edited with P4-specific behaviour (the auto-merge purge-drop, #7022). The dedicated P4 fragment was also added, so two fragments now describe overlapping surface for the same step.
  WHY: This is not a runtime defect. It is a doc-fragment isolation concern that raises merge-conflict risk and "two places to edit" drift.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2189-2199 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: WLA_TG_REPORT_FILE comes from the LLM-controlled step outputs steps.commit_report/analyze.outputs.report_file (line 2173), and the regex guard sits only in the analyze step. Inlining `${{ steps.commit_report.outputs.report_file }}` in a future edit would reopen an implicit-execution vector.
  WHY: The current code is correctly gated through env-then-shell indirection. The finding flags fragility only, to prevent a regression.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "480,000-byte guard (tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py): check with wc -c. Move large run: bodies into scripts/, passing ${{ }} values through env:."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml ("Dispatch & snapshot — workflow-log-analysis" step, lines 4243-4281) and .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml, plus a new scripts/*.sh holding a moved body
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff moves no run: body into scripts/ and adds no scripts/ file, yet both workflow files grow (about 20 lines in test-and-mark-stable.yml, about 160 lines in workflow-log-analysis.yml). The changed gate logic stays inline. The PR Acceptance table marks tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py "unmet" and the pre-push gate lists it as failing (inherited from the merge-base). Byte counts were not measured. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash skipped this gap as unverifiable: the PR adds about 1.3 KB to a workflow well under the guard.
- requirement: "Add changelog.d/analysis-findings-p4-purge-safety.md. Add an agents.d/ fragment, not a direct agents.md edit." (issue #9183); implement P4 in isolation using dedicated P4 fragments
  expected_change_site: agents.d/analysis-findings-p4-purge-safety.md, changelog.d/analysis-findings-p4-purge-safety.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The P4 implementation documented the `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PURGE_SKIPPED reason=auto_merge_pending` behaviour by editing the P1 fragments (agents.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md:6, changelog.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md) instead of the P4 fragments. agents.d/analysis-findings-p4-purge-safety.md:6 does not mention the auto-merge-pending drop. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5's notes call this invalid: the P1 files are not in this PR's changed files.
- requirement: "Fail closed on deletion: when in doubt, keep the doc." (linked issue body)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml lines 2070-2100 (`Commit and push report` step merge block)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The direct-merge path (line 2071-2074) does not drop purge deletions before arming a merge that may be queued; only the `else` branch at 2076-2099 implements the fail-closed drop.
- requirement: "The next `since_last_report=true` run starts at the largest `window_end` from analysis docs added in the last 8 days of history (no API call)" (changelog.d/agents.d analysis-findings-p4-purge-safety.md)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml lines 1676-1706 (window-marker write) and lines 209-296 (marker scan)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The window-marker write does not check `repos_override`, so single-repo dispatches produce markers that the next full-roster run consumes. "No gap" holds only when every run covers the full roster, and nothing enforces that.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1676-1706 (reader around lines 248-256) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The marker records only a time window, not which repos were collected. repos_override dispatches (input line 26, resolved 117-127), including the gate rollback at test-and-mark-stable.yml line 4261 (WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_GATE_ALL_REPOS=false), still publish a valid marker.
  WHY: The next since_last_report=true gate run takes the single-repo window_end as --since, which leaves a silent gap for the other roster repos and contradicts "overlap only, never a gap" (lines 1680-1681).
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "480,000-byte guard (tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py): check with wc -c. Move large run: bodies into scripts/, passing ${{ }} values through env:." The Acceptance table marks the test "unmet"; the pre-push gate lists it as failing (inherited from the merge-base).
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (about 20 lines added, lines 4243-4281), .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml (about 160 lines added), plus a new scripts/*.sh
  Evidence of absence: No run: body moved and no scripts/ file added while both workflows grow. Byte counts not measured (no shell). No run: body containing ${{ }} grew.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- NOTES (not findings, 4 related items): (1) direct-merge/merge-queue purge path (2070-2099) is base code, and the processing-report purge (1858-1864) plus apply_analysis_on_main.sh:345 and the in-flight guard (1845-1847) close #7022, so it is not a defect; (2) the P1 agents.d/changelog.d fragment findings are invalid because those files are not in this PR's changed files and the PR adds dedicated P4 fragments; (3) the line 2085 amend message is base code and cosmetic; (4) the P5 purge logic at 1834-1866 was checked and matches scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh, failing closed, with no issue.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: workflow-log-analysis.yml env of "Run workflow log analysis" (around 1291-1292) and the marker if-condition (around 1688). Add WLA_REPOS_OVERRIDE and skip the marker with a ::warning:: on single-repo runs, plus a test case in tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_since_last_report.py. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
